CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red positions) and a separate origin/representation status are both explicitly reported for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change claim linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Explicit identification of represented content (red) with coordinate attribute for a named referent/time.

D.rationale: Content entries (red positions) are presented separately from origin/representation metadata, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Explicit metadata describes how the content instance is represented/accessed (origin, represented_time) for the named referent.
